userStories.title: Add propose_patch LLM tool (action-dispatch: wiki / user_memory / operational targets)
userStories.description: Pure tool registration + types; no consumer wiring beyond writing to proposed_updates. (a) New file `internal/agent/tools/registry/propose_patch.go` with `ProposePatchTool` struct + Definition + Execute. Schema uses ActionDispatchOneOf (Phase-L pattern): action enum [wiki, user_memory, operational]; wiki requires target_slug + body + change_summary; user_memory requires fact + category (preference|fact|todo|person) + change_summary; operational requires tool_name + error_class + lesson + change_summary. Description copy: 'Submit a structured patch proposal for operator review. Proposals land in proposed_updates with status=pending and are visible in the dashboard /proposals review queue. Use action=wiki to suggest a wiki page edit, action=user_memory to surface a candidate user fact, action=operational to record an operational lesson. ALL writes are review-gated — no direct mutations.' (b) Execute validates payload by action, then inserts a proposed_updates row with kind matching action, status='pending', signature_hash for idempotency (sha256(action + key fields)[:16]), provenance source_run_id + actor_id. (c) For subagents (RiskTier='write_proposal') this is the ONLY mutation tool exposed — all direct write tools (wiki_page, agent_note set, source store) are filtered out via tool_allowlist. (d) Register in `internal/agent/tools/registry/registry.go` alongside subagent_dispatch + recall_*. (e) Tests `internal/agent/tools/registry/propose_patch_test.go`: 6 cases — wiki proposal creates row with kind='wiki' + status='pending'; user_memory proposal creates row with kind='user_memory'; operational proposal creates row with kind='operational'; double-submit same signature_hash is idempotent (skipped); missing required field per action returns schema validation error; tool exposed under a write_proposal subagent allowlist but blocks direct file/source writes.

userStories.title: Extend NodeSpec.RiskTier='write_proposal' + tool allowlist enforcement
userStories.description: Make write_proposal a valid RiskTier in Phase-R's NodeSpec.Validate. (a) Modify `internal/swarm/nodespec.go` (Phase-R US-R01) Validate function: accept RiskTier in {read_only, write_proposal}. When RiskTier='write_proposal', enforce that ToolAllowlist contains 'propose_patch' AND does NOT contain any direct-write tool (wiki_page, agent_note action=set|append|clear, source action=store, task action=schedule, file action=write|patch). Return descriptive error on violation. (b) Add helper `internal/swarm/tool_policy.go` with var `DirectWriteToolNames = []string{...}` (one source of truth) + function `EnforceWriteProposalAllowlist(allowlist []string) error`. (c) HubBridge.Dispatch (Phase-R US-R01) honors the new tier: passes tool_allowlist through ChannelData unchanged; the agent loop at hub layer applies the filter (verify Phase-R US-R02 hub.go has the tool_allowlist filter wired). (d) Tests in `internal/swarm/tool_policy_test.go`: 5 cases — read_only allows any tool name through; write_proposal with [propose_patch, web, search_memory] valid; write_proposal with [propose_patch, wiki_page] rejected (wiki_page is direct write); write_proposal with [web, search_memory] rejected (no propose_patch); empty allowlist rejected.

userStories.title: Extend subagent_dispatch tool: allow risk_tier param + propagate to NodeSpec

userStories.title: Integration test (parent + 2 write_proposal subagents) + TTL sweep + Phase-S closure docs
userStories.description: Lock end-to-end + add the proposals TTL sweep + close Phase-S. (a) New file `internal/swarm/write_proposal_integration_test.go` with `TestParentSpawnsTwoWriteProposalSubagentsAndCollectsProposals`: 1) seed actor with grants for CapabilityToolExecute + CapabilityMemoryUserWrite; 2) parent run spawns 2 write_proposal subagents — node A {goal: 'propose a wiki page about test'}, node B {goal: 'surface user preference: I like coffee'}; 3) assert collect returns aggregated markdown referencing the proposed_updates handles; 4) assert proposed_updates table has 2 new rows with status='pending', kinds matching expected (wiki + user_memory); 5) attempt direct wiki_page call from within a write_proposal subagent → assert ErrPermissionDenied or schema-validation error visible in agent_events. (b) Add TTL sweep: new file `internal/learning/proposal_ttl.go` with function `SweepStaleProposals(ctx, store, maxAge time.Duration) (purged int, err error)` — deletes proposed_updates rows with status='pending' older than maxAge. Default 30 days. Wire as new cron task 'proposal_ttl_sweep' running daily at 03:00 local. (c) Tests for SweepStaleProposals: 3 cases — fresh pending row preserved; 31-day-old pending row purged; approved row never purged regardless of age. (d) Closure docs: create `.planning/deep-refactor/Phase08_Cron_Swarm_Hub/subphases/Phase08_write_proposal_workers/{progress.md, plan.md, benchmark.md}`. Progress.md lists US-S01..S04 SHAs. Plan.md cites prd.md §Phase 8 line 1471 + master plan Wave 3 Pack C. Benchmark.md: 2 write_proposal subagents complete <60s on fake LLM. (e) Update prd.md §6.5 Status Checklist: add Phase-S row showing 'write-capable workers via propose_patch wired (Phase 8 second slice)'. (f) Update prd.md Phase 8 section: append 'Phase 8 second slice closed 2026-05-16 (write_proposal workers via propose_patch + TTL sweep). Full Phase 8 (team_collaboration, plan-execute, critic-review, hierarchical/hybrid DAG) remains deferred.' (g) Use git add -f for .planning/* paths.
